title: The prefix parser remains active
statement: For any three finite bit strings $b$, $\alpha$, and $x$, the prefix parser on the nested pair encoding $\langle\langle b,\alpha\rangle,x\rangle$ is still in a nonhalting state after $4|b|+2|\alpha|+5$ steps.
replaced:
After $4|b| + 2|\alpha| + 5$ steps on the nested pair encoding
$\langle \langle b, \alpha\rangle, x\rangle$ --- one step before consuming
the final separator cell --- the prefix parser has not halted.
